title: Software Engineer
education: B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or equivalent
description: Build and maintain full-stack web applications using React and Node.js with MongoDB. Work in a small product team on customer-facing features, REST APIs and cloud deployments.
responsibilities: Build scalable and responsive web applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.

title: AI Engineer
education: B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, AI or a related field
description: Design, train and deploy machine learning and deep learning models. Work on NLP and LLM-based features, evaluate model quality and ship models to production.
responsibilities: Train and evaluate machine learning models.
Build data and inference pipelines in Python.
Deploy models and monitor their performance.

title: Frontend Developer
education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
description: Create fast, accessible user interfaces for a web application using React and TypeScript. Work closely with designers to turn mockups into responsive components.
responsibilities: Turn design mockups into responsive pages.
Improve performance and accessibility of the web app.

title: Java Developer Intern
education: Pursuing or completed B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or equivalent
description: Internship for students learning backend development in Java. Work with a mentor on Spring Boot services, SQL databases and REST APIs.
responsibilities: Write and test small features in Java and Spring Boot.
Query and update data in SQL databases.
Use Git and code reviews to collaborate with the team.
